text:
### Observed differences

- In the earlier window, every case carried a closing block: about 50 in 100 cases (99 of 200) ended with A04 as the final event, and the other half (101 of 200) contained A06 and A10 together as an adjacent pair in either order (A06 before A10 in about 26 in 100 cases, A10 before A06 in about 25 in 100). A04 never co-occurred with A06 or A10. A02 fed this block: about 25 in 100 of its outgoing transitions went to A04, about 26 combined to A10/A06, 23 to A05, 12 to A09 and 12 to A03. [OCC003, OCC005, OCC009, REL026, REL030, REL039, DIR002, DIR006, DIR009, POS004]

- In the later window this block is rare: A04, A06 and A10 each appear in only about 20 in 100 cases (40, 43 and 43 of 200), A06/A10 co-occurrence fell from about 51 in 100 to about 22 in 100, and in about two-thirds of cases none of the three occurs at all. [OCC003, OCC005, OCC009, REL026, REL030, REL039]

- The three activities also lost their terminal role in the later window: A04 is followed by A08 in all 47 of its observed outgoing transitions, and A06 and A10 lead to A08 in about 44–56 in 100 of theirs (the A06↔A10 adjacency partly remains). Their average position moved from roughly the 88th–99th percentile of the trace to roughly the 60th–64th. [DIR004, DIR006, DIR009, POS004, POS006, POS010]

- Routing into the block changed: in the later window A02 no longer leads to A04, A06 or A10; its outgoing transitions now go mainly to A05 (about 46 in 100), A09 (21), A03 (21) and A01 (12). A03 and A09 gained edges into the block (A03→A04 about 23 in 100 of A03's outgoing transitions; A09→A04 about 21 in 100), and the previously common immediate successions A02→A04, A03→A08 and A09→A08 disappeared. [DIR002, DIR003, DIR008, LAG013, LAG026, LAG063]

- A02 and A08 sit later in the trace than before (A02 on average about 62% into the trace versus about 45% before; A08 about 72% versus 57%), and A02 more often ends the case: it still occurs about twice per trace, but its observed outgoing transitions fell from about 381 to about 219, and its 75th-percentile position is now the final event versus about two-thirds in before. [OCC001, DIR002, POS002, POS008]

- Smaller shifts: A03, A05, A07 and A09 participate somewhat more often (about 23→25, 29→36, 18→20 and 24→27 in 100 cases), A05 co-occurs a few points more often with A01 and A02, and A01's position is slightly more variable. [OCC002, OCC004, OCC006, OCC008, REL004, REL012, POS001]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the possibility that the closing stage of the process was restructured. In the earlier window, cases ended either with A04 or with the adjacent A06/A10 pair, reached from A02; in the later window, A04, A06 and A10 occur in only about one case in five, are reached from A03 or A09 instead of A02, and flow into A08 rather than ending the case, while A02 routes mainly to A05 and more often ends the case, with A08 occurring later than before. [OCC003, OCC005, OCC009, DIR002, DIR003, DIR004, DIR006, DIR008, DIR009, REL026, REL030, REL039, POS002, POS004, POS008]

The signs are direct and consistent across indicator families: the participation drops rest on about 200 traces per window and exceed about 995 of 1,000 random re-splits; the successor changes are observed on substantial transition counts (A02: 381 → 219 outgoing transitions; A04→A08: 47); and the relation profiles show the earlier strict-alternative structure between A04 and A06/A10 dissolving (co-occurrence 0 → 0.08, "neither" 0 → about 67 in 100). The position and succession shifts line up with the same rewiring rather than pointing to a separate difference. [OCC003, DIR002, DIR004, REL026, POS002, POS008, LAG013, LAG026, LAG063]

Limitations: A04's earlier context rests on a single observed outgoing transition, several gap items rest on fewer than about 15 observations per window, and many items describe the same traces, so they corroborate one underlying difference rather than independent changes; no screening baseline is included, so the number of qualifying items cannot be checked against a chance expectation. The main competing explanation the evidence cannot fully exclude is a changed mix of pre-existing case variants rather than one rewiring of the tail; the new A04/A06/A10→A08 successions and their earlier positions argue against a pure mix shift, but unobserved activities or edges could account for part of the pattern. [DIR004, DIR006, DIR009, POS004, POS006, POS010, LAG042, LAG052]

Other differences: A03, A05, A07 and A09 occur somewhat more often and A05 co-occurs slightly more with A01 and A02; A01 appears at slightly more variable positions; and the spacing between self-repetitions of A02, A05, A07, A08 and A09 shifted somewhat. These are reported separately and are not part of the main hypothesis. [OCC002, OCC004, OCC006, OCC008, REL004, REL012, POS001, LAG011, LAG032, LAG054]
